scientific_limitations: Only positive stretched-exponential unilateral shift weights on complex ell2, fixed c>0, alpha>0, 0<t<1 and 0<p<infinity. No uniform error estimates or extension to arbitrary compact shifts; pre-existing binomial Aluthge formula and qualitative Schatten convergence credited. An unpublished or unindexed general regular-variation result may cover part of the quantitative conclusion. Independent mathematical review not performed.
title: A sharp singular-value boundary layer for stretched-exponential Aluthge iterates
